EduTours in Singapore

Study trips customised to your learners. From 1 week and 10 students.

With 30,000 Japanese residents and 5300 Japanese companies, if your learners end up living abroad at some point in their lives, there’s a strong chance it will be here. There’s no better location to prepare students for a truly global future than in the most multi-cultural, English-speaking, technologically advanced country in Asia, with the highest standards of safety, living, and education as well as the best employment possibilities.

Our Edu-tours cater to universities (Nagoya, Meiji), high schools (Baiko, Obirin), and companies (JERA, JR) interested in English, sustainability, multiculturalism, AI, technology and innovation, leadership and entrepreneurship. Programs from 1 to 16 weeks can be fully customized with the most reasonable rates possible including accommodation. From pre-trip training apps to unforgettable team projects and experiences to post trip reflections and deep learning. Contact us to start exploring!

“The teachers really wanted me to actively communicate in English, so I felt motivated to speak up as much as possible! I was very grateful for the practice!”
